rationale: v1.3 is the credible baseline after causality fix. Later versions (v1.4-v1.9) show overfitting: every iteration improved backtest performance, 3 consecutive losing years masked by gold bull market. Calmar 1.02 at 1.5% gap stress is the honest benchmark.

credible_baseline.gap_stress_limit: 1.8% max tolerable daily gap; at 2.0% Calmar drops to 0.08

forward_recording.purpose: Accumulate unseen-data forward observations to validate v1.3 baseline
